US missionary kidnapped in Niger released after nine months in captivity. Kevin Rideout, a pilot with the evangelical missionary agency SIM International, was abducted in the capital, Niamey.

Israeli PM Netanyahu calls UK ‘the Islamic Republic of Britain’. The Israeli PM's remark comes amid signs of growing tension between Israel and the UK's Labour government.

Angel Reese smacked in the face by Sun's Aaliyah Edwards, has poor shooting night in Dream win. Angel Reese was hit in the face by Aaliyah Edwards during the Atlanta Dream's blowout win over the Connecticut Sun, leading to a Flagrant 1 upgrade.

Kyle Schwarber launches two homers into the corn after MLB's incredible HoF tribute at Field of Dreams game. The Field of Dreams MLB game featured 26 Hall of Fame players walking through the iconic cornfield before Kyle Schwarber's leadoff blast stole the show.

Anthony Richardson's turnovers in preseason opener raise more questions about his Colts future. Anthony Richardson threw an interception and fumbled in the Colts' preseason opener, raising more questions about his future as a backup quarterback.

White House exposes ‘Transshipment Scam’ costing US up to $26B, points finger at China. The White House report identifies over 40 countries posing elevated transshipment risk as China routes goods through third nations to dodge tariffs.

CNN calls out Patriot Games participants as 'overwhelmingly White,' citing outlet's analysis. Audie Cornish said a CNN analysis found Patriot Games athletes appear overwhelmingly White, and the White House fired back at criticism of the event.

Live bullet found aboard United flight forces passengers off plane for security sweep at Denver airport. A live bullet discovered aboard United Airlines Flight 1302 forced 178 passengers to deplane the Boeing 737-900 at Denver International Airport.

Seahawks sign former first-round Lions cornerback Terrion Arnold despite looming felony charges. Terrion Arnold signed with the Seattle Seahawks after the Detroit Lions released the cornerback following felony robbery and kidnapping charges.

Marco Rubio gets 68 new jobs in epic White House birthday gift inspired by viral meme. The gold-framed collage features 68 versions of the viral Marco Rubio meme, signed by Trump in gold ink, celebrating the secretary of state's birthday.

Netflix gives Elle Duncan another MLB showcase at Field of Dreams, baseball fans have seen enough. Major League Baseball's Field of Dreams game on Netflix featured 26 Hall of Famers, but Elle Duncan's hosting drew immediate social media backlash.

HHS warns Texas hospitals against denying life-saving care to newborn with disability. HHS warned Children's Medical Center of Dallas and UT Southwestern they cannot withhold treatment from baby Gabriel based on his heart defect.

Iran could unleash ‘kinetic’ response as US tightens economic containment, analyst warns. Analysts warn Iran could strike U.S. bases, ships, and Gulf infrastructure this fall as Trump's sanctions tighten and the Strait of Hormuz deadline looms.

Rams star Puka Nacua left bloodied in bizarre accident at Michael Rubin's star-studded White Party. Puka Nacua revealed on the "Impaulsive" podcast that he ended up bleeding after walking into a glass pane while trying to find Davante Adams.

Gun rights groups capitalize after judge reverses decades-old restrictions: 'Monumental'. Gun Owners of America members completed the first silencer transfers without National Firearms Act registration since 1934 after a court ruling.

Julianne Hough flaunts her toned figure in bikinis as she shares snaps from her trip to Sardinia. Julianne Hough shared photos from her Sardinia, Italy, girls trip featuring white string bikini beach moments, cliff jumping and seaside yoga.

David Foster denies snubbing Meghan Markle after red carpet interaction with Prince Harry. David Foster spoke out out after a red carpet video went viral, sparking speculation he had snubbed Meghan Markle. Foster said Prince Harry and Meghan are "dear friends."

Feds probe 'mention markets' amid White House Kalshi controversy. Betting on what people say is becoming an increasingly popular category of prediction market sites. Now, federal officials have opened a probe examining whether those markets are a magnet for manipulators.

Hit hard by the earthquake in western Colombia, the mayor of Cali gets to work. Search efforts continue though hopes are fading as teams dig for survivors from the 7.4 magnitude earthquake that killed more than 250 people.

Kennedy Center Board votes again to shut main building down — and add Trump's name back. The board voted to close the Washington, D.C., arts complex's main campus for a $250 million renovation — three months after a federal judge temporarily blocked a similar closure.

Mangione could plead guilty in federal case ahead of N.Y. murder trial. A surprise hearing this Friday in federal court has added to speculation that Luigi Mangione could enter a plea, which could derail a state murder trial.
Vladimir Putin's first visit to disputed Pacific islands draws Tokyo protest. The four southernmost islands of the chain also are claimed by Japan, which calls them the Northern Territories.

By sky and sea, Ukraine's drone strikes challenge Russia's grip on Crimea. Russia maintained an iron grip on Crimea since seizing it from Ukraine in 2014. Many Russian civilians go there to enjoy the beaches. But now Ukraine is hitting Crimea hard, upending daily life.
Taiwan briefly slows its mobile internet to text-only speed as part of defense drill. The drills come amid rising tensions with China, which frequently sends military planes and ships towards Taiwan.

Inflation eased slightly in July. And, ICE plans to give officers electric shock gloves. Inflation cooled a bit last month, according to a new report from the Labor Department. And, ICE plans to equip its officers with electric shock gloves.

The drug lenacapavir is a mighty weapon against HIV. Its rollout gets mixed reviews. It's a twice-a-year injection that is remarkably effective in preventing an HIV infection. Distribution is starting. But questions are being raised about getting it to the areas that need it most.

Primary voters send mixed signals about what they want from the Democratic Party. Primary results this month in Michigan, Minnesota and Wisconsin paint a muddled picture of just how far to the left Democratic voters want their candidates to be come this fall's midterm elections.
